title: CareSys
voice: Care work starts with people. Meet CareSys. It helps agencies organize the day, while caregivers stay in control of their careers.

title:
Your career
Your choices
voice: Your experience matters. Build a profile that reflects your skills, the languages you speak, and where you'd like to work. Helpful examples guide you along the way.

title:
Recruit with
a clear purpose
voice: Looking for your next team member? Explore approved profiles, manage applications, and invite candidates. Each person chooses how they'd like to respond.

title:
Control what
you share
voice: Your career story is yours to share. Choose which history to disclose, who can see it, and how long access lasts.

title:
Clear agreements
Explicit joining
voice: When it's time to join a team, clear decisions matter. Review the contract version, record agreement, and give separate permission to join.

title:
Coordinate
daily work
voice: Bring the daily plan together. Assign visits, check availability and qualifications, and keep care notes and incident records where the team can review them.

title:
Keep reviews
accountable
voice: Make time reviews easier to follow. Record online clock events and breaks, then review worked time and correction requests with a clear record of decisions.

title:
Connect agency
operations
voice: Keep agency operations connected. Track expenses, equipment, invoices, and receipts. Export approved worked time for the next payroll step. External payroll submission is still planned.

title:
A platform
with room to grow
voice: Today, CareSys has a working local web application. Android and iPhone apps, regional pricing, and commercial hosting are on the roadmap.

title: Explore CareSys
voice: Ready to explore CareSys? Take a closer look and discuss a pilot for your agency. Support your team, with people at the heart of the work.
